rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P affirmed BBB on Jackson Hospital & Clinic Series 2015 bonds and revised outlook to negative from stable, reflecting operating-pressure trajectory.

moodys._warning: No 2018-2019 Moody's action surfaced; Baa2 stable assumed to carry forward from 2015 initial assignment. Moody's downgrade to Ba3 occurred in August 2022, well outside window.

outcome_class_rationale: S&P revised outlook to negative March 2017 (early in window) but rating itself held at BBB. Moody's Baa2 likely stable through window (no rating action found pre-2022). 2017-2019 outcome is mild deterioration captured in S&P negative outlook — no downgrade. Full distress (Ba3 / B / default) occurred 2022-2024, well outside window.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Industry-typical estimates for 350-bed Montgomery AL community hospital at BBB/Baa2. Not extracted from audited financials. Series 2015 bonds $60M per S&P rationale; full balance sheet not retrieved.

_research_notes: Jackson Hospital is Montgomery AL community hospital (non-public-authority). Standalone independent through 2017-2019. Eventual default and 2024 'D' rating well outside window. Within 2017-2019, the right read is 'mild deterioration via S&P negative outlook' — no actual downgrade or merger event.
